PS5 and PS4 are supported. It also works if the console is wired and the phone is on Wi-Fi from the same router.

You only do this the first time. On PS4: Settings › Remote Play Connection Settings › Add Device.
Tap “Connect to Console”. Once connected, tap “Open subtitles”: subtitles fill the screen. Put your phone in landscape beside you.
Adjust text size with A− / A+ at the bottom. Scroll up to read earlier lines.
A second user for the controller

Because the app uses your main account, your controller can't use that account. Create a second user on the console. After connecting, press the PS button on the controller, choose that user and play with it.
You create the second user once. The game keeps running on your TV; saves and trophies go to that user.
Every game puts subtitles in a different place. If no translation appears or menu text gets mixed in, open “Subtitle Area” and drag the yellow box over the game's subtitle.
It's easiest on the game's subtitle settings screen: most games show a sample subtitle there.
